rci1_using_msad.detail: REST-meta-MDD Project is multi-site (site 20) and is combined with HCP for normative model construction
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "To construct the normative models, we downloaded phenotypic data and MRI T1-weighted data from the Human Connectome Project (dataset II; 510 HC participants; age range, 22 -36 years) (28) and REST-meta-MDD Project (dataset III; 229 HC participants; age range, 18 -65 years; site 20) (29)."
